newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA sells AVA Bank to GE Capital.
newsitem.headline: CA sells AVA Bank to GE Capital.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein said on Monday it had sold its AVA-Bank unit to GE Capital in a deal worth more than one billion schillings ($81.7 million).
GE Capital will take over all leasing and credit activities, shareholding interests, branches and AVA's brand name, Creditanstalt said in a statement.
Creditanstalt said it would retain various real estate businesses and savings investments. ($ = 12.23 Austrian Schillings)
AVA-Bank has company capital worth 1.1 billion schillings and total assets of around 13 billion schillings.
AVA-Bank's main interests which will be taken over by GE Capital are Kreditbank, Fiat-Bank, Wiesenthal-Bank, Denzel-Bank, Interunfall-Leasing as well as Wiener Allianz Leasing.
No further details were made available. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12274
